scripts.build: node -e "try{const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');fs.rmSync('.next/cache',{recursive:true,force:true});if(fs.existsSync('.next/static/chunks')){fs.mkdirSync('.chunks_bak',{recursive:true});cp.execSync('cp -r .next/static/chunks/* .chunks_bak/ || true');}}catch(e){}" && NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=2048" next build && node -e "try{const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');if(fs.existsSync('.chunks_bak')){cp.execSync('cp -rn .chunks_bak/* .next/static/chunks/ || true');fs.rmSync('.chunks_bak',{recursive:true,force:true});}}catch(e){}"
